subject: Re: Quick follow-up + economic buyer intro — Redwood inference demo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@helixthera.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + economic buyer intro — Redwood inference demo

Hi Samira — thanks again for taking time today to walk through your use case (user-facing summarization at scale). Quick recap and next steps from my side:

- What we heard: high throughput requirements (~2M tokens/day peak), strict latency targets for interactive flows (<200ms p95), and procurement constraints for customer data residency.
- Primary technical contacts: John Lee (engineering) — we’ll follow up on model variants and latency profile.
- As discussed, the next important step is an intro to the economic/budget owner so we can align on commercial fit and timelines. Can you loop in whoever owns the budgeting for ML infrastructure?

Attached: short discovery notes and a link to the Redwood intro deck. I’ve cc'd Vivek from our solutions team — he can join the budget conversation if helpful.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Intro to economic buyer + confirm budget window and procurement cadence
2) 30-min pricing + deployment options call with budget owner
3) Proof-of-concept scope & timeline (2–4 weeks)

Would love an intro this week if possible.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143

Attachments: Discovery-notes-helix-20270522.pdf, Redwood-Intro-Deck.pdf

From: Samira Khan <skhan@helixthera.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Lee <john.lee@helixthera.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + economic buyer intro — Redwood inference demo

Thanks Marissa — great recap.

John and I chatted after the demo. John will take point on the technical follow-up (latency profiling + sequence-length distribution) with Vivek. On the procurement side, budgeting lives with our VP Finance / CRO stack — Sarah O'Connor (sarah.oconnor@helixthera.com). I can introduce you both. Our target is to lock budget in Q3 with procurement work wrapping in July.

Looping in John for technical follow-ups and will add Sarah on the intro thread now.

–Samira
Senior Product Manager, Helix Therapeutics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah O'Connor <sarah.oconnor@helixthera.com>, Samira Khan <skhan@helixthera.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed next steps (Redwood + Helix)

Hi Sarah — nice to e-meet you, and thank you Samira for the intro.

Brief context: we ran a short demo with the product and infra teams yesterday to show Redwood’s inference stack for low-latency, high-throughput summarization. Our ask: confirm whether commercial fit + timing are aligned so we can scope a PoC that fits your procurement window.

Proposed next steps (short):
- 30-min commercial call: pricing bands, contract cadence, and procurement questions (we’ll share a clean one-pager).
- Technical sync: John + Vivek to review latency targets and deployment options (dedicated vs hosted).
- PoC proposal: independent scope and success metrics for a 2–4 week evaluation.

Quick question to help prep the call: what is the budget range or approval threshold we should plan to present (ballpark is fine), and who on your side manages procurement/legal? If there’s an internal procurement portal/process (DocuSign/Ariba), please point us to the contact or link.

I’ve attached a short pricing one-pager for reference. Available windows this week: Tue/Thu 9–11am PT, Wed 2–4pm PT. Happy to work around Sarah’s schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143

Attachments: Pricing-one-pager.pdf
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HLX-2027-033

From: Sarah O'Connor <sarah.oconnor@helixthera.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <skhan@helixthera.com>
Cc: John Lee <john.lee@helixthera.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed next steps (Redwood + Helix)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear plan. I own the budgets for product/ML tooling. A few quick data points to help you prepare: 

- Budget window: Q3 FY27 planning cycle; we have a flexible bucket for vendor trials but need executive sign-off for multi-quarter commitments. Ballpark approval threshold for me to greenlight to procurement is ~$150k ARR.
- Procurement/legal: procurement@helixthera.com will handle SOW and standard vendor agreements; for any security questionnaires we route to security@helixthera.com.
- Timeline: aim to decide on PoC vendor by mid-July; procurement paperwork to complete by end of July if we proceed.

Can you share a short pricing snapshot for a PoC and standard terms (data residency, audit access, SOC2 evidence)? If it helps, we can run the 30-min commercial call Thursday 10am PT.

Best,
Sarah O'Connor
VP Finance & Operations, Helix Therapeutics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah O'Connor <sarah.oconnor@helixthera.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <skhan@helixthera.com>, John Lee <john.lee@helixthera.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed next steps (Redwood + Helix)

Thanks Sarah — really helpful. I’ve summarized answers below and attached a clean pricing snapshot and our SOC2 summary for procurement.

- PoC pricing: $25k flat for a 4-week PoC (covers dedicated capacity and support hours) — scalable into committed pricing if you convert.
- Standard terms: we support US and EU data residency on Dedicated plans; SOC2 Type II evidence and audit logs are available for enterprise contracts.
- Procurement: happy to work with procurement@helixthera.com; we can provide an SOW + standard vendor agreement and shortcut SOC2 evidence.

I’ll schedule the 30-min commercial call Thu 10am PT (inv to follow). Next actions: I’ll send the invite, and Vivek will pick a time with John for the technical sync.

Appreciate the clarity on thresholds — we’ll tailor the commercial convo accordingly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Pricing-one-pager.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf
